story.heading: When the ads cost more than they brought in
paragraphs: One client runs two tree service companies in South Florida. In his line of work, a homeowner with a storm-damaged tree calls the first company that looks trustworthy — and doesn't wait.
His old WordPress site opened slowly, Google barely showed it, and the money he put into ads wasn't coming back. Visitors he paid for left before the page had even loaded.
We rebuilt both sites in Astro and set up SEO from the ground up. The pages now open instantly, score 100 for SEO, and the ad budget finally turns into phone calls.

Ad spend that didn't pay back

faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: The things clients ask before we start.

items.question: What does a website cost?
items.answer: Every project gets one fixed price, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no surprises afterwards. The free talk — and the free check, if there's already a website — tells me what your project needs, and you get the price in one clear proposal.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: That depends on the size of the website. The proposal names the timeline together with the price, so you know both before we start.

items.question: What happens with my current website?
items.answer: It stays online until the new one is ready. Your content, your web address, and your Google rankings come along. I check your current website before our first talk, so you get clear answers from the start.

items.question: Do I need to arrange hosting or a domain?
items.answer: No. I set up the hosting and the domain for you, in your own name. If you already have a domain, we simply keep it.

items.question: Do we need to meet in person?
items.answer: It's not needed. Most projects run entirely by phone, video, and email. I work with clients worldwide, and time zones are rarely a problem.

items.question: Are you a company or agency?
items.answer: I'm a one-person business: a freelancer, not an agency. You work directly with the person doing the work, from the first talk to the finished website. No sales team, no account managers, no handoffs.

items.question: Can I change the website myself after launch?
items.answer: You can simply send me your changes, and the monthly care plan exists exactly for that. If you want to edit the website yourself, say so in the first talk and I set the site up for it.

items.question: Do you also build webshops?
items.answer: No. Big online shops are the one thing I don't build. Everything else that needs a custom Astro website, I build: tell me in the first talk what you have in mind, and I'll be honest about whether I'm the right builder for it.

items.question: Is the website really mine?
items.answer: Completely. The domain, the hosting, and the code are in your name from day one. If you ever want to move on, you take everything with you: you're never locked in.

items.question: What happens if something breaks after launch?
items.answer: Very little can break: the website has no plugins and no database to fail. And I stay reachable after launch; for regular updates and monitoring there is the monthly care plan.

items.question: Do you offer graphic design or branding on its own?
items.answer: Yes. A logo, a brand identity, or ongoing graphic design work is available on its own, without a full website rebuild — tell me what you need in the first talk.

items.question: Do you run paid ads like Google Ads?
items.answer: Yes, end to end: campaign structure, budget, keyword and landing-page alignment, and the conversion tracking that shows what the spend is actually buying.

items.question: Can you handle my social media marketing?
items.answer: Yes — Instagram and Facebook campaigns with real conversion tracking built in, so results are judged by bookings and leads, not just engagement.

items.question: What is Generative Engine or AI SEO?
items.answer: Making sure AI assistants and AI-powered search — ChatGPT, Google's AI Overviews — read your site correctly and recommend your business, alongside traditional SEO.

items.question: Do you offer fixed-price website packages?
items.answer: Yes, for businesses with a clear scope in mind: a packaged design keeps the price and the deliverable fixed from the start, without a lengthy discovery process.

items.question: What does hosting and domain setup actually include?
items.answer: I choose and set up reliable hosting for your site and register — or transfer — your domain, both in your own name from day one. SSL, DNS, and a business email address at your domain are part of the same setup.

items.question: Do I pay you or the hosting provider directly?
items.answer: The domain and hosting accounts are yours, billed directly to you by the provider. I don't sit between you and the bill — I just make sure it's the right setup and keep it running.

items.question: Can I keep my current domain?
items.answer: Yes. If you already have one, we point or transfer it to the new site — your existing email addresses and domain history don't need to change.

items.question: What if my hosting or domain has a problem?
items.answer: That's covered by the monthly care plan: I monitor uptime and renewal dates, and deal directly with the host or registrar if anything goes wrong.

items.question: Do prices change after the first year?
items.answer: Domain and hosting renewal prices are set by the registrar and host, not by me, and I flag them before they renew — no surprise increases hidden in a bundled fee.
